title: GetDigital Awards 2026
summary: Celebrating the people and small businesses helping Ugandans use technology with confidence.
description: The GetDigital Awards recognise the teachers, young innovators, community trainers and small businesses who make technology useful for the people around them. Nominations came from the public in October. Vote for the nominee you believe has done the most this year. Winners are announced at the Gala Night on 19 December 2026.

title: Best Community Digital Hub 2026
summary: Which community space did the most to get people online this year?
description: Community hubs give people a place to charge a phone, use a computer, learn a skill and get online. Vote for the hub that made the biggest difference in your area. The winning hub receives two laptops and a year of data from our partners.
imageAlt: Young people using computers at a community digital hub

categories.description: A public space where people learn and get online.

title: Student AI Project Showcase 2027
summary: Secondary and university students show what they built with AI. The public picks the People's Choice winner.
description: Students from across Uganda submit projects that use AI to solve a local problem. Judges pick the category winners; the public vote decides the People's Choice award. Project submissions close on 10 January 2027.

title: Lira Digital Skills Challenge 2025
summary: Our first public vote, celebrating learners from the 2025 digital skills classes in Lira.
description: Learners from the 2025 GetDigital classes in Lira showed what they learned. The public voted for the most improved learner and the best small business website.
